name: rich-inspection-provenance-and-source-mapping
instr:
Rich cannot trace rendered inspection content to the object member or source substring that produced it. Add provenance through replacement, styled-text composition, recursive rendering, layout, and width changes, preserving existing behavior when provenance is not requested.

Make `SourceOrigin` and `ProvenanceMap` public from `rich.provenance`. Immutable mappings must return deterministic `origins(self, start, end=None)` and `slice(self, start, end)` results for preserved, expanded, discarded, concatenated, and zero-width ranges. `ProvenanceMap.replace` performs direct emoji replacement and, when provenance is requested, returns the output with its mapping. Replacement and markup must preserve exact input identity for displayed content, including unknown emoji aliases and escaped delimiters. Syntax has no displayed origin, and malformed markup exposes no partial result. Composition copies and rebases provenance without aliasing mutable state. Styling, highlighting, slicing, and mutation retain source coverage.

Give containers, keys, values, repeated references, and cycle placeholders distinct semantic paths during recursive rendering. Repeated references share an observable underlying-object identity marker. Table rows have distinct semantic row and column origins after measurement, wrapping, padding, omitted cells, and cropping. Decoration and padding remain unowned.

Make `InspectionPath`, `RenderedOrigin`, `InspectionReport`, `InspectionChange`, and `InspectionDiff` pub
